title.en: Which separating line? The widest street
title.zh: 选哪条分隔线？选最宽的"街道"

text.en: When two classes can be separated by a line, there are infinitely many lines that do it, and all have zero training error. The perceptron takes whichever it stumbles on first; logistic regression takes the one that maximises the likelihood. The **support vector machine** (SVM) asks a geometric question: which line stays **as far as possible from both classes**?
text.zh: 两个类别若能被一条直线分开，那么有无穷多条直线都能做到，训练误差都是零。感知机取它先碰到的那一条；逻辑回归取似然最大的那一条。**支持向量机**（SVM）问的是一个几何问题：哪条线离**两个类别都尽可能远**？

alt.en: A maximum-margin line in 2D: the boundary, the two margin lines, the circled support vectors and the width 2/‖w‖.
alt.zh: 二维里的最大间隔直线：决策边界、两条间隔线、圈出的支持向量与宽度 2/‖w‖。

text.en: Think of the widest street that fits between the classes, with the boundary down its middle. The **margin** is the half-width of that street. Why this helps generalisation: a test point is classified wrongly only if noise pushes it across the boundary, and the wider the empty street, the bigger the push needed. Only the points on the edge of the street, the **support vectors**, decide where it can be.
text.zh: 想象能塞进两类之间的最宽的街道，边界就是街道的中线。**间隔**（margin）是街道的半宽。它为什么有利于泛化：测试点只有被噪声推过边界才会判错，空街道越宽，需要的推力越大。街道的位置只由街边的点，也就是**支持向量**（support vectors），决定。

prompt.en: Two lines both classify every training point correctly. Line A has margin 0.5, line B has margin 2. The hard-margin SVM prefers…
prompt.zh: 两条线都把所有训练点分对。线 A 的间隔是 0.5，线 B 是 2。硬间隔 SVM 偏好……

label.en: A, because a narrow margin means it fits the data more tightly.
label.zh: A，因为间隔窄意味着它更贴合数据。

feedback.en: A tight fit to the training points is what we do not want: it sits close to some points and tolerates less noise.
feedback.zh: 紧贴训练点正是我们不想要的：它离某些点很近，容忍的噪声更少。

label.en: Either: both have zero training error.
label.zh: 都可以：两个训练误差都是零。

feedback.en: SVM does not stop at zero error; among all separating lines it optimises the margin.
feedback.zh: SVM 不止于训练误差为零；在所有能分开的直线里它优化间隔。

label.en: B: it leaves the widest empty street.
label.zh: B：它留出最宽的空街道。

explain.en: Maximum margin is the criterion that picks one line out of the infinitely many that separate the data.
explain.zh: 最大间隔是从无穷多条可分直线里挑出一条的准则。

title.en: The hyperplane $\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x} + b = 0$ and the labels $\pm 1$
title.zh: 超平面 $\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x} + b = 0$ 与标签 $\pm 1$

text.en: A linear classifier scores a point by $f(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x} + b$ and predicts its sign: $\hat{y} = \text{sign}(f(\mathbf{x}))$. The deck writes $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ and $\theta_0$; here they are $\mathbf{w}$ and $b$, the usual SVM names, and the bias is kept separate.
text.zh: 线性分类器用 $f(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x} + b$ 给点打分，预测其符号：$\hat{y} = \text{sign}(f(\mathbf{x}))$。课件写作 $\boldsymbol{\theta}$ 与 $\theta_0$；这里叫 $\mathbf{w}$ 与 $b$，是 SVM 通用的记号，偏置单独写。

items.en: **Boundary**: $\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x} + b = 0$, a hyperplane (a line for $d=2$, a plane for $d=3$).
items.zh: **边界**：$\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x} + b = 0$，一个超平面（$d=2$ 是直线，$d=3$ 是平面）。

items.en: **$\mathbf{w}$ is perpendicular to the boundary**: for two points on it, $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = 0$ and $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}' + b = 0$ give $\mathbf{w}^\top(\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{x}') = 0$, so $\mathbf{w}$ is orthogonal to every direction *inside* the plane. It points to the $+1$ side.
items.zh: **$\mathbf{w}$ 垂直于边界**：边界上两点满足 $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = 0$ 与 $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}' + b = 0$，相减得 $\mathbf{w}^\top(\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{x}') = 0$，所以 $\mathbf{w}$ 与平面*内部*的每个方向都正交。它指向 $+1$ 的一侧。

items.en: **The offset $b$** slides the plane parallel to itself. Without it the plane must pass through the origin; allowing it can widen the margin a lot (slide 27).
items.zh: **偏置 $b$** 让平面平行移动。没有它，平面必须过原点；允许它，间隔可以大得多（第 27 页）。

title.en: Labels are $-1/+1$, not $0/1$

body.en: Logistic regression coded the classes 0 and 1 (so that $y$ could be a probability). The SVM codes them $-1$ and $+1$ so that **$y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) > 0$ exactly when the point is on the correct side**. Everything below uses that product.
body.zh: 逻辑回归把类别编码为 0 和 1（这样 $y$ 才能当概率）。SVM 编码为 $-1$ 和 $+1$，使得**点在正确一侧当且仅当 $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) > 0$**。下面的一切都用这个乘积。

title.en: How far is a point from the hyperplane?
title.zh: 一个点离超平面有多远？

say.en: Split $\mathbf{x}_i$ into its foot $\mathbf{x}_p$ on the hyperplane plus a step of signed length $r$ along the unit normal $\mathbf{w}/\|\mathbf{w}\|$. $|r|$ is the distance we want.
say.zh: 把 $\mathbf{x}_i$ 拆成它在超平面上的垂足 $\mathbf{x}_p$，加上沿单位法向量 $\mathbf{w}/\|\mathbf{w}\|$ 走的一步，带符号长度为 $r$。$|r|$ 就是要求的距离。

say.en: The foot lies on the hyperplane.
say.zh: 垂足在超平面上。

say.en: Apply $\mathbf{w}^\top(\cdot) + b$ to the split. The foot part is zero, and $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{w} = \|\mathbf{w}\|^2$.
say.zh: 对拆分式作用 $\mathbf{w}^\top(\cdot) + b$。垂足那部分为零，且 $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{w} = \|\mathbf{w}\|^2$。

say.en: Solve for $r$: the **signed distance**, positive on the $+1$ side. (This is the deck's $\cos\beta$ picture on slide 9: the projection of $\mathbf{x}_i$ on $\mathbf{w}$.)
say.zh: 解出 $r$：**带符号的距离**，在 $+1$ 一侧为正。（这就是课件第 9 页的 $\cos\beta$ 图：$\mathbf{x}_i$ 在 $\mathbf{w}$ 上的投影。）

say.en: Multiply by the label $y_i = \pm 1$: the result is positive for every correctly classified point, whichever side it is on. This is the clever trick of slide 49.
say.zh: 乘以标签 $y_i = \pm 1$：对每个分类正确的点结果都是正的，无论它在哪一侧。这就是第 49 页说的巧妙之处。

say.en: A check with numbers: the point is at distance 4 on the positive side.
say.zh: 用数字检验：这个点在正的一侧，距离是 4。

intro.en: The margin is a distance, so first the formula for the distance from a point to a hyperplane.
intro.zh: 间隔是一个距离，所以先推点到超平面距离的公式。

outro.en: Two names. The **functional margin** of a point is $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b)$; the **geometric margin** is that divided by $\|\mathbf{w}\|$, the true distance. The margin of the whole classifier is the smallest over the training set, $\gamma_g = \min_i y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b)/\|\mathbf{w}\|$ (slide 11). Rescaling $(\mathbf{w}, b) \to (c\mathbf{w}, cb)$ leaves the boundary and $\gamma_g$ alone but multiplies the functional margin by $c$: so only the geometric margin is meaningful.
outro.zh: 两个名字。点的**函数间隔**（functional margin）是 $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b)$；**几何间隔**（geometric margin）是它除以 $\|\mathbf{w}\|$，即真实的距离。整个分类器的间隔是训练集上的最小值，$\gamma_g = \min_i y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b)/\|\mathbf{w}\|$（第 11 页）。把 $(\mathbf{w}, b)$ 换成 $(c\mathbf{w}, cb)$，边界和 $\gamma_g$ 都不变，函数间隔却乘以 $c$：所以只有几何间隔有意义。

title.en: From "maximise the margin" to a quadratic program
title.zh: 从"最大化间隔"到二次规划

say.en: The idea in symbols (slides 16-17): find the line whose smallest geometric margin $\gamma$ is as large as possible. Every point must be at distance $\ge \gamma$.
say.zh: 把想法写成符号（第 16-17 页）：找一条线，使它最小的几何间隔 $\gamma$ 尽可能大。每个点离线的距离都必须 $\ge \gamma$。

say.en: Scaling freedom: $(\mathbf{w}, b)$ and $(c\mathbf{w}, cb)$ are the same line. So we may *choose* the scale in which the closest point has functional margin exactly 1. This only fixes the scale; it loses nothing (slide 18, “for mathematical convenience”).
say.zh: 缩放自由度：$(\mathbf{w}, b)$ 和 $(c\mathbf{w}, cb)$ 是同一条线。所以可以*选定*一种尺度，使最近的点的函数间隔恰好为 1。这只是固定尺度，不损失任何东西（第 18 页“为数学上的方便”）。

say.en: Substitute $\gamma = 1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$ everywhere.
say.zh: 到处代入 $\gamma = 1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$。

say.en: Multiply each constraint by $\|\mathbf{w}\| > 0$: the nasty fraction is gone and the constraint is **linear** in $(\mathbf{w}, b)$.
say.zh: 每个约束乘以 $\|\mathbf{w}\| > 0$：难看的分式消失，约束对 $(\mathbf{w}, b)$ 变成**线性**的。

say.en: Making $1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$ big means making $\|\mathbf{w}\|$ small (slide 20).
say.zh: $1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$ 大，就是 $\|\mathbf{w}\|$ 小（第 20 页）。

say.en: Square it and add $\tfrac12$: on positive numbers $\|\mathbf{w}\|$ and $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ have the same minimiser, but the square is smooth (no root) and its derivative is just $\mathbf{w}$. This is the **hard-margin SVM** (slide 21).
say.zh: 平方再乘 $\tfrac12$：对正数，$\|\mathbf{w}\|$ 与 $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ 的最小点相同，但平方是光滑的（没有根号），导数就是 $\mathbf{w}$。这就是**硬间隔 SVM**（第 21 页）。

outro.en: A **quadratic program** (QP): a quadratic objective and linear constraints. It is **convex**, so it has one global optimum and no local traps (the deck's pro on slide 48), unlike a neural network's loss. Contrast with logistic regression: no likelihood, no probabilities, just geometry.
outro.zh: 这是一个**二次规划**（QP）：二次目标加线性约束。它是**凸**的，所以只有一个全局最优、没有局部陷阱（课件第 48 页的优点），不像神经网络的损失。与逻辑回归对比：没有似然，没有概率，只有几何。

title.en: Why the margin is $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$
title.zh: 为什么间隔宽度是 $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$

say.en: In the scale we fixed, the closest points satisfy $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$: positives on $H_+$, negatives on $H_-$. Both are parallel to the boundary $H_0$ (slide 22).
say.zh: 在我们选定的尺度下，最近的点满足 $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$：正例在 $H_+$ 上，负例在 $H_-$ 上。两者都与边界 $H_0$ 平行（第 22 页）。

say.en: The shortest way from $H_-$ to $H_+$ goes along the normal $\mathbf{w}$. Take $\mathbf{x}_-$ on $H_-$ and walk $\lambda$ times $\mathbf{w}$.
say.zh: 从 $H_-$ 到 $H_+$ 的最短路沿法向量 $\mathbf{w}$。取 $H_-$ 上的 $\mathbf{x}_-$，沿 $\mathbf{w}$ 走 $\lambda$ 倍。

say.en: Subtract the two plane equations: $b$ cancels.
say.zh: 两个平面方程相减：$b$ 抵消。

say.en: Substitute $\mathbf{x}_+ - \mathbf{x}_- = \lambda\mathbf{w}$ into the line above.
say.zh: 把 $\mathbf{x}_+ - \mathbf{x}_- = \lambda\mathbf{w}$ 代入上一行。

say.en: The distance between the planes is the **width of the street**, $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$; the margin (half of it) is $1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$.
say.zh: 两个平面之间的距离就是**街道的宽度** $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$；间隔（它的一半）是 $1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$。

intro.en: Check the picture with algebra: the two margin lines are $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = \pm 1$. How far apart are they?
intro.zh: 用代数检验这幅图：两条间隔线是 $\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b = \pm 1$，它们相距多远？

outro.en: So **small $\|\mathbf{w}\|$ = wide street**: minimising $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ *is* maximising the margin. The same “small weights” idea appears as regularisation in logistic regression, which is not an accident (see the hinge page).
outro.zh: 所以 **$\|\mathbf{w}\|$ 小 = 街道宽**：最小化 $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ *就是*最大化间隔。“权重小”这个想法在逻辑回归里以正则化的面目出现，这不是巧合（见 hinge 一页）。

title.en: Support vectors, and the limits of the hard margin
title.zh: 支持向量，以及硬间隔的局限

text.en: At the optimum, the points whose constraint is **tight**, $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$, lie exactly on the margin lines. These are the **support vectors**; every other point has slack to spare. The solution is **sparse**: the boundary is determined by the support vectors alone (slide 23). Move or delete any other point and nothing changes.
text.zh: 在最优解处，约束**取等号**的点，$y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$，恰好落在间隔线上。这些就是**支持向量**；其他点都有富余。解是**稀疏**的：边界只由支持向量决定（第 23 页）。移动或删掉别的点，什么都不变。

text.en: Is sparse good? Yes, and it gives a cheap estimate of test error (slide 24). In leave-one-out cross-validation, removing a non-support vector leaves the classifier unchanged, so that point is still classified correctly. Only removing a support vector can cause a mistake. Hence the leave-one-out error is at most $N_s / n$, with $N_s$ the number of support vectors:
text.zh: 稀疏是好事吗？是的，而且它给出一个便宜的测试误差估计（第 24 页）。留一交叉验证里，删掉一个非支持向量，分类器不变，这个点仍被分对。只有删掉支持向量才可能出错。因此留一误差至多是 $N_s / n$，其中 $N_s$ 是支持向量的个数：

prompt.en: You delete one training point that is **not** a support vector and retrain a hard-margin SVM. The new boundary is…
prompt.zh: 你删掉一个**不是**支持向量的训练点，重新训练硬间隔 SVM。新的边界……

label.en: slightly different: every point contributes a little.
label.zh: 略有不同：每个点都有一点贡献。

feedback.en: That is how logistic regression behaves. For the SVM, a point strictly outside the margin has no influence at all.
feedback.zh: 这是逻辑回归的行为。对 SVM，严格在间隔之外的点完全没有影响。

label.en: exactly the same.
label.zh: 完全相同。

label.en: wider, because there is more room.
label.zh: 更宽，因为空间更大了。

feedback.en: The margin is set by the *closest* points, the support vectors; removing a far point does not change them.
feedback.zh: 间隔由*最近*的点，即支持向量决定；删掉远处的点不会改变它们。

explain.en: Only the support vectors are in the constraints that are tight, so only they shape the solution.
explain.zh: 只有支持向量对应的约束取等号，所以只有它们塑造解。

text.en: Two weaknesses of the hard margin (slides 28-29)
text.zh: 硬间隔的两个弱点（第 28-29 页）

items.en: **Sensitive to outliers and label errors**: one stray point close to the other class can drag the boundary and shrink the street dramatically.
items.zh: **对离群点和标签错误敏感**：一个靠近另一类的游离点，就能把边界拉偏、把街道大大压窄。

items.en: **No solution if the data are not linearly separable**: the constraints $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) \ge 1$ cannot all hold, and the QP is infeasible.
items.zh: **数据线性不可分时无解**：约束 $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) \ge 1$ 不可能全部成立，QP 无可行解。

text.en: Both are fixed by letting some points break the rules for a price: the soft margin, later in this lesson. First, the machinery that explains support vectors and makes kernels possible.
text.zh: 两者都靠“让一些点付出代价、允许它们违规”来解决：本课后面的软间隔。先讲能解释支持向量、并使核方法成为可能的那套工具。

title.en: Optimising under a constraint: the deck's toy problem
title.zh: 带约束的优化：课件里的小例子

say.en: Slide 13. Without the constraint the minimum is at $z = 1$, which breaks $z \ge 3$. The answer must lie on the allowed set, and by the picture it is the allowed point closest to 1: $z^* = 3$. Now find it by a method that will also work for the SVM.
say.zh: 第 13 页。没有约束时最小点在 $z = 1$，但它违反 $z \ge 3$。答案必须在允许的集合里，从图上看是离 1 最近的允许点：$z^* = 3$。现在用一种同样适用于 SVM 的方法把它求出来。

say.en: The **Lagrangian**: add the constraint, times a multiplier $\alpha \ge 0$, to the objective. For $z < 3$ the added term is positive: a **penalty for violating** the constraint. ($\alpha$ is how much the constraint is worth.)
say.zh: **拉格朗日函数**：把约束乘上乘子 $\alpha \ge 0$ 加到目标上。$z < 3$ 时新增的项为正：对违反约束的**惩罚**。（$\alpha$ 是这条约束值多少钱。）

say.en: Stationarity: set the derivative in the variable to zero.
say.zh: 驻点条件：对变量的导数取零。

say.en: **Complementary slackness**: either the multiplier is zero, or the constraint is tight. A constraint with room to spare costs nothing, so its price must be 0.
say.zh: **互补松弛**：要么乘子为零，要么约束取等号。有富余的约束不花代价，所以它的价格必须是 0。

say.en: Try both cases. The first is infeasible. The second works.
say.zh: 两种情形都试一下。第一种不可行，第二种成立。

say.en: The constraint is **active** ($\alpha > 0$): it pushes back with force 4. Had the unconstrained minimum been allowed, we would have found $\alpha = 0$. The SVM does exactly this, with one multiplier per training point.
say.zh: 约束是**起作用的**（$\alpha > 0$）：它以力 4 顶了回来。若无约束的最小点本来就被允许，我们会得到 $\alpha = 0$。SVM 做的正是这件事，每个训练点一个乘子。

intro.en: To see why only some points matter, and why kernels work, we need one tool: the Lagrangian. Learn it on the deck's one-variable example.
intro.zh: 要看清为什么只有一些点起作用、为什么核方法行得通，需要一个工具：拉格朗日函数。先在课件的一元例子上学会它。

title.en: Deeper: the SVM Lagrangian and the two stationarity conditions
title.zh: 深入：SVM 的拉格朗日函数与两个驻点条件

say.en: The primal, with each constraint written as “something $\ge 0$”, as in the toy.
say.zh: 原问题，每个约束写成“某个量 $\ge 0$”的形式，和刚才的小例子一样。

say.en: One multiplier $\alpha_i$ per training point: the price of its constraint.
say.zh: 每个训练点一个乘子 $\alpha_i$：它的约束的价格。

say.en: $P^*$, the primal value. Why this is the same problem: if some constraint is violated, its bracket is negative, so $-\alpha_i[\cdot]$ can be made arbitrarily large and the max is $+\infty$. If all hold, the best $\alpha_i$ are 0 and the max equals $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$. So the inner max enforces the constraints automatically.
say.zh: $P^*$ 是原问题的值。为什么这是同一个问题：若某个约束被违反，它的括号为负，$-\alpha_i[\cdot]$ 可以任意大，max 是 $+\infty$。若全部满足，最优的 $\alpha_i$ 为 0，max 等于 $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$。所以内层的 max 自动强制了约束。

say.en: Swap the order to get $D^*$, the dual value. In general $D^* \le P^*$ (weak duality), but for a convex objective with linear constraints the two are **equal** (strong duality), so we may solve whichever is easier.
say.zh: 交换顺序得到 $D^*$，对偶问题的值。一般有 $D^* \le P^*$（弱对偶），但对凸目标加线性约束，两者**相等**（强对偶），所以可以解较容易的那个。

say.en: Inner minimisation, in $\mathbf{w}$ first. The derivative of $\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ is $\mathbf{w}$; of $\alpha_i y_i \mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i$ it is $\alpha_i y_i\mathbf{x}_i$. So **$\mathbf{w}$ is a weighted sum of the training points**, label-signed.
say.zh: 先对 $\mathbf{w}$ 做内层最小化。$\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ 的导数是 $\mathbf{w}$；$\alpha_i y_i \mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i$ 的导数是 $\alpha_i y_i\mathbf{x}_i$。所以 **$\mathbf{w}$ 是训练点的加权和**，带标签的符号。

say.en: Then in $b$. Only the term $-b\sum_i\alpha_i y_i$ contains $b$. The condition says the total push on the boundary from the $+1$ points equals that from the $-1$ points (forces balance).
say.zh: 再对 $b$。只有 $-b\sum_i\alpha_i y_i$ 这一项含 $b$。这个条件说：$+1$ 点对边界的总推力等于 $-1$ 点的总推力（力平衡）。

intro.en: The same recipe as the toy, now with $n$ constraints. Part 1: set up and differentiate.
intro.zh: 和小例子同一套办法，只是现在有 $n$ 个约束。第 1 部分：建立并求导。

title.en: Deeper: the dual problem
title.zh: 深入：对偶问题

say.en: Start from the Lagrangian and expand the bracket.
say.zh: 从拉格朗日函数出发，把括号展开。

say.en: The $b$ term vanishes because $\sum_i \alpha_i y_i = 0$. In the second term, pull $\mathbf{w}^\top$ out of the sum.
say.zh: $b$ 项消失，因为 $\sum_i \alpha_i y_i = 0$。第二项里把 $\mathbf{w}^\top$ 提到求和外面。

say.en: The bracket is exactly $\mathbf{w}$ (the first stationarity condition).
say.zh: 括号里恰好是 $\mathbf{w}$（第一个驻点条件）。

say.en: Write $\mathbf{w}$ as the sum twice and multiply out.
say.zh: 把 $\mathbf{w}$ 写成两次求和再相乘。

say.en: The **dual**: a problem in the $n$ multipliers only; $\mathbf{w}$ and $b$ are gone. It is a concave QP (so again one optimum).
say.zh: **对偶问题**：只含 $n$ 个乘子；$\mathbf{w}$ 和 $b$ 都消失了。它是凹的 QP（同样只有一个最优点）。

say.en: Prediction also uses $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$.
say.zh: 预测同样用 $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$。

intro.en: Part 2: put $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$ and $\sum_i \alpha_i y_i = 0$ back into $\mathcal{L}$ to eliminate $\mathbf{w}$ and $b$.
intro.zh: 第 2 部分：把 $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$ 与 $\sum_i \alpha_i y_i = 0$ 代回 $\mathcal{L}$，消掉 $\mathbf{w}$ 和 $b$。

outro.en: Look at where the data appear: **only inside dot products** $\mathbf{x}_i^\top \mathbf{x}_j$, both in training and in prediction. That is the door to kernels.
outro.zh: 看看数据出现在哪里：**只出现在点积** $\mathbf{x}_i^\top \mathbf{x}_j$ 里，训练和预测都是。这就是通向核方法的门。

title.en: Deeper: complementary slackness, or why only support vectors count
title.zh: 深入：互补松弛，为什么只有支持向量起作用

text.en: At the optimum the **KKT conditions** hold. The one that matters for interpretation is complementary slackness, as in the toy example:
text.zh: 在最优点，**KKT 条件**成立。对解释最重要的是互补松弛，和小例子里一样：

rows.en: outside or on the margin; **no influence** on $\mathbf{w}$
rows.zh: 在间隔外或边上；对 $\mathbf{w}$ **没有影响**

rows.en: exactly on a margin line: a **support vector**
rows.zh: 恰在间隔线上：**支持向量**

text.en: So in $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$ every non-support vector has weight 0: **the sum runs over the support vectors only**, which is the sparsity of slide 23, now derived. A picture to remember: each support vector pushes on the street with a force $\alpha_i$, the plane rests where the forces balance ($\sum_i \alpha_i y_i = 0$), and a point with no contact (outside the street) pushes with force 0.
text.zh: 所以在 $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$ 中，每个非支持向量的权重都是 0：**求和只在支持向量上进行**，这就是第 23 页的稀疏性，现在推出来了。可以这样记：每个支持向量以力 $\alpha_i$ 推着街道，平面停在力平衡处（$\sum_i \alpha_i y_i = 0$），而没接触的点（在街外）推力为 0。

text.en: The bias comes from any support vector $s$: $y_s(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_s + b) = 1$ and $y_s = \pm 1$ give $b = y_s - \mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_s$.
text.zh: 偏置由任一支持向量 $s$ 得到：$y_s(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_s + b) = 1$ 且 $y_s = \pm 1$，得 $b = y_s - \mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_s$。

prompt.en: A training point has $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) = 2.5$ at the optimum. Its multiplier $\alpha_i$ is…
prompt.zh: 最优点处某训练点满足 $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) = 2.5$。它的乘子 $\alpha_i$ 是……

label.en: positive, because it is classified correctly.
label.zh: 正的，因为它被分对了。

feedback.en: Correct classification is not enough: $\alpha_i > 0$ needs the point to sit *on* the margin line ($y_i f = 1$).
feedback.zh: 分对还不够：$\alpha_i > 0$ 需要点恰好*在*间隔线上（$y_i f = 1$）。

label.en: between 0 and 1, depending on the distance.
label.zh: 在 0 和 1 之间，取决于距离。

feedback.en: Multipliers are not tied to distance like that; for a point with slack to spare the bracket is non-zero, so $\alpha_i$ must be 0.
feedback.zh: 乘子并非这样与距离挂钩；有富余的点，括号非零，所以 $\alpha_i$ 必为 0。

label.en: zero: the constraint is not tight, so it costs nothing.
label.zh: 零：约束没取等号，不花代价。

explain.en: $\alpha_i[y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) - 1] = 0$ with the bracket equal to $1.5 \neq 0$ forces $\alpha_i = 0$.

title.en: Deeper: the dual solved by hand on the figure's data
title.zh: 深入：在图中的数据上手算对偶问题

say.en: The data of the figure. By eye the two circled points are the support vectors, so every other $\alpha_i = 0$. (We verify afterwards that the others are outside the street.)
say.zh: 图中的数据。目测圈出的两个点是支持向量，所以其他 $\alpha_i$ 都为 0。（最后会验证其余点都在街外。）

say.en: The balance constraint: the two forces are equal.
say.zh: 平衡约束：两个力相等。

say.en: The dot products the dual needs.
say.zh: 对偶问题需要的点积。

say.en: Insert into $W$. The cross term carries $y_1 y_3 = -1$, which is why it is subtracted twice.
say.zh: 代入 $W$。交叉项带有 $y_1 y_3 = -1$，所以被减去两次。

say.en: Maximise: set the derivative to zero.
say.zh: 最大化：导数取零。

say.en: $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$ over the support vectors.
say.zh: $\mathbf{w} = \sum_i \alpha_i y_i \mathbf{x}_i$，只对支持向量求和。

say.en: The bias from a support vector.
say.zh: 由一个支持向量得到偏置。

say.en: Two checks. The street width equals the distance between the two support vectors. And the primal value equals the dual value (strong duality).
say.zh: 两个检验。街道宽度等于两个支持向量之间的距离。原问题的值等于对偶问题的值（强对偶）。

intro.en: Now run the dual on a tiny problem: the four-plus-four points of the first figure, whose support vectors are $(3,3)$ and $(1,1)$.
intro.zh: 现在在一个小问题上跑一遍对偶：第一幅图里的四加四个点，支持向量是 $(3,3)$ 与 $(1,1)$。

outro.en: Every other point has $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) > 1$ (for example $(4,5)$ gives $2.5$, $(0,1)$ gives $1.5$), so $\alpha_i = 0$ was right.
outro.zh: 其余的点都满足 $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) > 1$（例如 $(4,5)$ 得 $2.5$，$(0,1)$ 得 $1.5$），所以 $\alpha_i = 0$ 是对的。

title.en: Deeper: the kernel trick
title.zh: 深入：核技巧

title.en: Beyond the deck
title.zh: 超出课件的内容

body.en: The deck says kernel methods are not covered. This page and the next are for depth; the exam will not ask you to derive kernels. Knowing the idea and the names is enough.
body.zh: 课件说核方法不在范围内。这一页和下一页是为了加深理解；考试不会要求推导核。知道想法和名字就够了。

text.en: Some data are not linearly separable in the original space, but become so after a feature map $\phi$ that adds features (squares, products). The dual shows how to use $\phi$ without paying for it: the data enter only as dot products, so replace each by a **kernel**
text.zh: 有些数据在原空间里线性不可分，但用特征映射 $\phi$ 加上新特征（平方、乘积）之后就可分了。对偶问题告诉我们怎样用 $\phi$ 而不付出代价：数据只以点积出现，所以把每个点积换成一个**核函数**

text.en: The trick: computing $K$ directly is often far cheaper than computing $\phi$, which may have a huge or even infinite number of coordinates. The classifier is still linear, but in the $\phi$-space, so its boundary in the original space is curved. Everything above (margin, support vectors, sparsity) carries over unchanged.
text.zh: 诀窍：直接算 $K$ 往往比算 $\phi$ 便宜得多，$\phi$ 可能有巨大甚至无穷多个坐标。分类器在 $\phi$ 空间里仍是线性的，所以在原空间里边界是弯的。上面的一切（间隔、支持向量、稀疏性）原样保留。

rows.en: a polynomial surface up to degree $d$
rows.zh: 至多 $d$ 次的多项式曲面

rows.en: smooth, local blobs around the support vectors; infinite-dimensional $\phi$
rows.zh: 围绕支持向量的光滑局部"团块"；$\phi$ 是无穷维的

text.en: The RBF kernel is a similarity: 1 when $\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{z}$, falling to 0 with distance. Large $\gamma$ makes each support vector's reach tiny, so the boundary wiggles around single points (overfit); small $\gamma$ makes it smooth, nearly linear. A valid kernel must give a symmetric positive semi-definite Gram matrix $[K(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{x}_j)]$ (Mercer's condition); that guarantees it equals a dot product for *some* $\phi$.
text.zh: RBF 核是一种相似度：$\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{z}$ 时为 1，随距离增大衰减到 0。$\gamma$ 大，每个支持向量的影响范围很小，边界围着单个点扭动（过拟合）；$\gamma$ 小，边界光滑、近乎线性。合法的核必须使 Gram 矩阵 $[K(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{x}_j)]$ 对称半正定（Mercer 条件），这保证它对*某个* $\phi$ 等于点积。

title.en: Deeper: a kernel is a dot product in disguise, as $(\mathbf{x}^\top \mathbf{z})^2$ shows
title.zh: 深入：核是伪装的点积，以 $(\mathbf{x}^\top \mathbf{z})^2$ 为例

say.en: The degree-2 polynomial kernel (with $c = 0$) on two features.
say.zh: 两个特征上的二次多项式核（$c = 0$）。

say.en: Expand the square.
say.zh: 展开平方。

say.en: Regroup as a dot product of two 3-vectors: put $\sqrt2$ in each so the middle product is $2x_1x_2z_1z_2$. So the explicit feature map is $\phi(\mathbf{x}) = (x_1^2, \sqrt2\,x_1x_2, x_2^2)$.
say.zh: 重新组合成两个三维向量的点积：每边放一个 $\sqrt2$，使中间项乘出 $2x_1x_2z_1z_2$。所以显式的特征映射是 $\phi(\mathbf{x}) = (x_1^2, \sqrt2\,x_1x_2, x_2^2)$。

say.en: A number check, the kernel route: one dot product in the original 2D space and a square.
say.zh: 用数字检验，走核的路线：在原来的二维空间里做一次点积再平方。

say.en: The feature route: map both points to 3D first.
say.zh: 特征的路线：先把两个点映射到三维。

say.en: The same 25. The kernel gave the 3D dot product without ever forming the 3D vectors.
say.zh: 同样是 25。核没有构造三维向量，就给出了三维空间里的点积。

say.en: Why bother: XOR (positives on one diagonal, negatives on the other) cannot be split by any line in 2D. After $\phi$ the third coordinate $\sqrt2\,x_1x_2$ is $+\sqrt2$ for one class and $-\sqrt2$ for the other, so the plane $\phi_3 = 0$ separates them, which is a curved (hyperbola-shaped) boundary back in the plane.
say.zh: 为什么要这样做：XOR（正例在一条对角线上、负例在另一条上）在二维里没有直线能分开。映射之后第三个坐标 $\sqrt2\,x_1x_2$ 对一类是 $+\sqrt2$，对另一类是 $-\sqrt2$，平面 $\phi_3 = 0$ 就把它们分开了，回到原平面上就是一条弯的（双曲线形）边界。

intro.en: Check the claim $K(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{z}) = \phi(\mathbf{x})^\top\phi(\mathbf{z})$ for one kernel, symbolically and with numbers.
intro.zh: 对一个核，用符号和数字各检验一次 $K(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{z}) = \phi(\mathbf{x})^\top\phi(\mathbf{z})$。

title.en: The soft margin: slack variables
title.zh: 软间隔：松弛变量

text.en: Real data have overlap, outliers and label errors. The fix: let each point $i$ break its margin constraint by an amount $\xi_i \ge 0$ (the **slack**), but charge for it.
text.zh: 真实数据有重叠、离群点和标签错误。办法：允许每个点 $i$ 违反它的间隔约束，违反量是 $\xi_i \ge 0$（**松弛**），但要收费。

alt.en: A soft-margin solution: support vectors with slack 0, between 0 and 1, and above 1.
alt.zh: 一个软间隔的解：松弛为 0、介于 0 与 1、大于 1 的支持向量。

rows.en: on or outside its margin line
on the line: a support vector; outside: no influence
rows.zh: 在线上：支持向量；在外面：没有影响

rows.en: inside the street, still on the correct side
rows.zh: 在街道里面，但仍在正确的一侧

rows.en: a support vector, classified correctly with low margin
rows.zh: 支持向量，分类正确但间隔小

rows.en: on the wrong side of the boundary

text.en: The last row explains why the penalty makes sense: a misclassified point has $\xi_i > 1$, so $\sum_i \xi_i$ is an upper bound on the number of training mistakes. The margin is still read as $1/\|\mathbf{w}^*\|$ (slide 33). Notice that now **three kinds of points are support vectors**: on the margin, inside it, and misclassified.
text.zh: 最后一行说明了惩罚为什么合理：被分错的点有 $\xi_i > 1$，所以 $\sum_i \xi_i$ 是训练错误个数的上界。间隔仍读作 $1/\|\mathbf{w}^*\|$（第 33 页）。注意现在**三类点都是支持向量**：在间隔线上的、在间隔里面的、被分错的。

title.en: What $C$ trades off
title.zh: $C$ 在权衡什么

text.en: $C$ is the price of one unit of slack. The objective balances two wishes: a wide street ($\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ small) and few violations ($C\sum\xi_i$ small).
text.zh: $C$ 是一单位松弛的价格。目标在两个愿望之间折中：街道宽（$\tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$ 小）、违规少（$C\sum\xi_i$ 小）。

alt.en: The same data fitted with C = 100, 1 and 0.1: the street widens as C falls.
alt.zh: 同一份数据用 C = 100、1、0.1 拟合：C 越小，街道越宽。

rows.en: overfitting; outliers pull the boundary (towards the hard margin as $C \to \infty$)
rows.zh: 过拟合；离群点拉动边界（$C \to \infty$ 趋向硬间隔）

rows.en: underfitting; the boundary ignores real structure
rows.zh: 欠拟合；边界忽略真实结构

text.en: Compare with regularisation: dividing the objective by $C$ gives $\sum_i \xi_i + \frac{1}{2C}\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$, so $1/C$ plays the role of $\lambda$: **small $C$ = strong regularisation**. As on slides 42-44, $C$ also changes the solution on separable data, since the soft problem is solved even then. $C$ is a hyperparameter chosen by cross-validation, never by training error.
text.zh: 和正则化对照：目标除以 $C$ 得 $\sum_i \xi_i + \frac{1}{2C}\|\mathbf{w}\|^2$，所以 $1/C$ 的角色就是 $\lambda$：**$C$ 小 = 正则化强**。如第 42-44 页所示，即使在可分数据上 $C$ 也会改变解，因为软间隔问题那时也在求解。$C$ 是超参数，用交叉验证选，不能靠训练误差选。

prompt.en: Training error is 0 but test error is high, and $C = 10^4$. A sensible next step?
prompt.zh: 训练误差为 0、测试误差很高，且 $C = 10^4$。合理的下一步是？

label.en: Increase $C$ further to punish any remaining errors.
label.zh: 继续增大 $C$，惩罚剩下的任何错误。

feedback.en: That pushes towards the hard margin and makes overfitting worse.
feedback.zh: 这会趋向硬间隔，让过拟合更严重。

label.en: Lower $C$ (and pick it by cross-validation).
label.zh: 降低 $C$（并用交叉验证来选）。

label.en: Nothing: zero training error means the model is optimal.
label.zh: 什么都不用做：训练误差为零说明模型最优。

feedback.en: Zero training error with a high test error is the signature of overfitting.
feedback.zh: 训练误差为零而测试误差高，正是过拟合的特征。

explain.en: Lowering $C$ widens the street, tolerates a few training errors, and usually generalises better.
explain.zh: 降低 $C$ 会加宽街道、容忍少量训练错误，通常泛化更好。

summary.en: Deeper: the soft-margin dual and the three cases
summary.zh: 再深一点：软间隔的对偶与三种情形

text.en: The dual is the same $W(\boldsymbol{\alpha})$ with one change: the box constraint $0 \le \alpha_i \le C$ (the multiplier of $\xi_i \ge 0$ forces the cap). Complementary slackness then gives the three cases of the slack table:
text.zh: 对偶问题还是同一个 $W(\boldsymbol{\alpha})$，只改了一处：盒约束 $0 \le \alpha_i \le C$（$\xi_i \ge 0$ 的乘子迫使出现上界）。互补松弛于是给出松弛表里的三种情形：

text.en: $C$ is the most any single point can push, which is why a small $C$ stops an outlier from dragging the boundary.
text.zh: $C$ 是单个点能施加的最大推力，这就是为什么小 $C$ 能阻止离群点拉偏边界。

title.en: Deeper: the soft margin is the hinge loss plus a penalty
title.zh: 深入：软间隔就是 hinge 损失加惩罚

say.en: The two constraints on slack, restated with the score $f$.
say.zh: 关于松弛的两个约束，用得分 $f$ 重写。

say.en: The objective charges $C\xi_i$, so for fixed $(\mathbf{w}, b)$ each $\xi_i$ sits at the *smallest* value both constraints allow: the larger of the two bounds.
say.zh: 目标对 $\xi_i$ 收费 $C\xi_i$，所以对固定的 $(\mathbf{w}, b)$，每个 $\xi_i$ 取两个约束允许的*最小*值：两个下界中较大的那个。

say.en: Substitute: the slack variables are gone and the constraints with them. An unconstrained problem.
say.zh: 代入：松弛变量没有了，约束也随之消失。变成无约束问题。

say.en: The **hinge loss** $\ell_h$ of the (functional) margin $m$: zero once $m \ge 1$ (safely outside the street), then growing linearly as the point enters the street and crosses the boundary.
say.zh: 关于（函数）间隔 $m$ 的 **hinge 损失** $\ell_h$：$m \ge 1$ 之后为零（安全地在街外），之后点进入街道、越过边界时线性增长。

say.en: Divide by $C$: the SVM is **a loss plus an $L_2$ penalty on the weights**, the same recipe as regularised logistic regression with only the loss changed.
say.zh: 除以 $C$：SVM 就是**一个损失加上对权重的 $L_2$ 惩罚**，和正则化的逻辑回归是同一个配方，只是损失换了。

intro.en: Eliminate the slack variables to see what the SVM is really minimising.
intro.zh: 消去松弛变量，看 SVM 到底在最小化什么。

title.en: SVM, logistic regression, perceptron
title.zh: SVM、逻辑回归、感知机

alt.en: Losses against the margin m = y·f(x): 0-1, hinge, logistic (scaled to pass through (0,1)) and the perceptron loss.
alt.zh: 损失随间隔 m = y·f(x) 的变化：0-1 损失、hinge、logistic（缩放后过 (0,1)）、感知机损失。

text.en: All three are linear classifiers $\text{sign}(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b)$. They differ in the loss on the margin $m = y\,f(\mathbf{x})$, and therefore in which line they pick.
text.zh: 三者都是线性分类器 $\text{sign}(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b)$。区别在于它们对间隔 $m = y\,f(\mathbf{x})$ 用什么损失，因此挑出的直线也不同。

rows.en: any separating line, depends on the order of updates
rows.zh: 任一可分直线，取决于更新顺序

rows.en: maximum likelihood; every point pulls a bit
rows.zh: 最大似然；每个点都拉一点

rows.en: maximum margin; only support vectors pull
rows.zh: 最大间隔；只有支持向量在拉
带符号的得分（距离），没有概率
没问题（有正则化时权重有限）

text.en: The picture is the point: logistic loss and hinge loss are close cousins (both smooth or piecewise-linear upper bounds of the 0-1 loss). The hinge is **exactly zero beyond $m = 1$**, so well-classified points drop out entirely and only the support vectors matter; the logistic loss never reaches zero, so every point still pulls. The perceptron's loss is zero for $m \ge 0$: it is happy with a point just barely on the right side, hence no margin pressure.
text.zh: 这幅图就是要点：logistic 损失和 hinge 损失是近亲（都是 0-1 损失的上界，一个光滑、一个分段线性）。hinge 在 **$m = 1$ 之后恰好为零**，分得好的点完全退场，只有支持向量起作用；logistic 损失永远不到零，所以每个点都还在拉。感知机的损失在 $m \ge 0$ 时就为零：点刚好在正确一侧它就满足了，因此没有扩大间隔的压力。

prompt.en: Which model gives you $P(y = 1 \mid \mathbf{x})$ directly, without extra post-processing?
prompt.zh: 哪个模型直接给出 $P(y = 1 \mid \mathbf{x})$，不需要额外后处理？

label.en: The SVM: the score is the distance to the boundary, so it is a probability.
label.zh: SVM：得分是到边界的距离，所以是概率。

feedback.en: A distance is unbounded and not calibrated. Probabilities from an SVM need an extra step (e.g. Platt scaling).
feedback.zh: 距离没有界，也没有校准。SVM 要得到概率需要额外一步（例如 Platt 缩放）。

label.en: Logistic regression.
label.zh: 逻辑回归。

label.en: The perceptron: it outputs 0 or 1, which are the probabilities.
label.zh: 感知机：它输出 0 或 1，就是概率。

feedback.en: A hard label is not a calibrated probability: it says nothing about confidence.
feedback.zh: 硬标签不是校准的概率：它不说明置信度。

explain.en: Only logistic regression models $P(y \mid \mathbf{x})$; the SVM and perceptron give decisions.
explain.zh: 只有逻辑回归建模 $P(y \mid \mathbf{x})$；SVM 和感知机给出的是决策。

title.en: More than two classes, and other tasks
title.zh: 多于两类，以及其他任务

text.en: An SVM is binary by construction: a hyperplane has two sides (slide 45). The deck's way (slide 46): give each of the $k$ classes its own weight vector $\boldsymbol{\theta}_1, \dots, \boldsymbol{\theta}_k$ and **learn them jointly**, requiring the correct class to score higher than every other class by a margin of 1:
text.zh: SVM 天生是二分类：超平面只有两侧（第 45 页）。课件的做法（第 46 页）：给 $k$ 个类别各一个权重向量 $\boldsymbol{\theta}_1, \dots, \boldsymbol{\theta}_k$，并且**联合学习**，要求正确类别的得分比其他每个类别都高出 1 的间隔：

text.zh: 想法和前面一样：间隔现在是正确类别的得分与最高的错误类别得分之差。另外两种把问题化为二元 SVM 的常见做法（教材内容）：

rows.zh: 每个分类器的训练数据

rows.en: all the data (class $c$ against the rest)
rows.zh: 全部数据（类别 $c$ 对其余）

text.en: Slide 47 adds that SVMs are used beyond classification: **rating** (e.g. movies), **ranking** (e.g. search results) and **structured prediction** (e.g. dependency parsing, protein structure), by changing what the margin constraints compare.
text.zh: 第 47 页补充，SVM 的用途不限于分类：**评分**（如电影）、**排序**（如搜索结果）、**结构化预测**（如依存句法分析、蛋白质结构），做法是改变间隔约束所比较的对象。

title.en: Strengths, weaknesses, and when to pick it
title.zh: 优缺点，以及什么时候选它

rows.en: the widest street tolerates the most noise; points near the boundary are not trusted
rows.zh: 最宽的街道容忍最多的噪声；不信任靠近边界的点

rows.en: a QP: one global optimum, no local minima
rows.zh: QP：只有一个全局最优，没有局部最小

rows.en: the margin does not depend on the number of features; the solution is sparse in the data
rows.zh: 间隔不依赖特征个数；解对数据是稀疏的

rows.en: Sensitive to outliers and label errors
rows.zh: 对离群点和标签错误敏感

rows.en: one bad point can move the support vectors, and the boundary with them (hard margin)
rows.zh: 一个坏点就能移动支持向量，边界也随之移动（硬间隔）

rows.en: the hard-margin constraints cannot all hold; needs the soft margin
rows.zh: 硬间隔的约束不可能全部成立；需要软间隔

rows.en: large $C$: few violations but narrow margin; small $C$: wide margin but many violations
rows.zh: $C$ 大：违规少但间隔窄；$C$ 小：间隔宽但违规多
只有线性边界（普通 SVM）

rows.en: non-linear data needs kernel methods (not covered in the subject)
rows.zh: 非线性数据需要核方法（本课程不讲）

text.en: Pick an SVM when the data are high-dimensional or small and you want a strong, regularised linear classifier without probabilities. Prefer logistic regression when you need calibrated probabilities, and a different model when the structure is clearly non-linear and you do not use a kernel.
text.zh: 数据维度高、或样本少，并且想要一个强而有正则的线性分类器、不需要概率时，选 SVM。需要校准的概率时，选逻辑回归；结构明显非线性又不用核时，选别的模型。

title.en: Practice: the width of the street
title.zh: 练习：街道的宽度

prompt.en: A trained hard-margin SVM has $\mathbf{w} = (1.5,\ 2)$ and $b = 0.5$, in the scale where the support vectors satisfy $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$. How wide is the street between the two margin lines, $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$?
prompt.zh: 训练好的硬间隔 SVM 有 $\mathbf{w} = (1.5,\ 2)$、$b = 0.5$，所取尺度使支持向量满足 $y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top \mathbf{x}_i + b) = 1$。两条间隔线之间的街道有多宽，即 $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$？

explain.en: $\|\mathbf{w}\| = \sqrt{1.5^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{6.25} = 2.5$, so the width is $2/2.5 = 0.8$ (each side of the boundary has $1/2.5 = 0.4$). $b$ does not matter: it only slides the street.

title.en: Practice: an RBF kernel value
title.zh: 练习：一个 RBF 核的值

prompt.en: The RBF kernel is $K(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{z}) = \exp(-\gamma\,\|\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{z}\|^2)$. Compute it for $\gamma = 0.2$, $\mathbf{x} = (1, 2)$, $\mathbf{z} = (2, 0)$ (2 decimal places).
prompt.zh: RBF 核是 $K(\mathbf{x}, \mathbf{z}) = \exp(-\gamma\,\|\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{z}\|^2)$。对 $\gamma = 0.2$、$\mathbf{x} = (1, 2)$、$\mathbf{z} = (2, 0)$ 计算它（保留两位小数）。

explain.en: $\|\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{z}\|^2 = (1-2)^2 + (2-0)^2 = 1 + 4 = 5$, so $K = \exp(-0.2 \cdot 5) = e^{-1} = 0.368$. A value between 0 and 1: the two points are moderately similar.

title.en: Practice: the effect of $C$
title.zh: 练习：$C$ 的作用

prompt.en: A soft-margin SVM is trained twice on the same data, with $C = 0.01$ and $C = 100$. Which description is correct?
prompt.zh: 同一份数据上训练两次软间隔 SVM，$C = 0.01$ 和 $C = 100$。哪一个描述是对的？

label.en: $C = 100$: narrower margin, fewer training violations, higher risk of overfitting.
label.zh: $C = 100$：间隔更窄、训练违规更少、过拟合风险更高。

label.en: $C = 100$: wider margin, because a larger $C$ means a stronger regulariser.
label.zh: $C = 100$：间隔更宽，因为 $C$ 越大正则化越强。

feedback.en: It is the other way round: $C$ multiplies the *violation* penalty, so large $C$ is *weak* regularisation. The regulariser is $1/C$.
feedback.zh: 正相反：$C$ 乘的是*违规*惩罚，所以 $C$ 大是*弱*正则化。正则化强度是 $1/C$。

label.en: $C = 0.01$: more support vectors are misclassified because the margin is narrower.
label.zh: $C = 0.01$：间隔更窄，所以更多支持向量被分错。

feedback.en: Small $C$ gives a *wider* margin, which usually puts *more* points inside it; the margin is not narrower.
feedback.zh: $C$ 小给出*更宽*的间隔，通常使*更多*点落在间隔里；间隔并不窄。

label.en: The two give the same boundary on separable data.
label.zh: 在可分数据上两者给出相同的边界。

feedback.en: Not in general: the soft-margin problem trades margin against slack even when the data are separable (slides 42-44).
feedback.zh: 一般不会：即使数据可分，软间隔问题也在间隔与松弛之间权衡（第 42-44 页）。

explain.en: Large $C$ makes slack expensive, so the optimiser narrows the street to cut violations.
explain.zh: $C$ 大使松弛很贵，所以优化器会收窄街道来减少违规。

title.en: Practice: who is a support vector?
title.zh: 练习：谁是支持向量？

prompt.en: After training a soft-margin SVM, which of these points is **not** a support vector (so deleting it would not change the solution)?
prompt.zh: 训练软间隔 SVM 之后，下面哪个点**不是**支持向量（删掉它不会改变解）？

label.en: A point exactly on a margin line, with $\xi = 0$.
label.zh: 恰好在间隔线上的点，$\xi = 0$。

feedback.en: A point on the margin line has $y_i f = 1$ and typically $\alpha_i > 0$: it is a support vector.
feedback.zh: 间隔线上的点 $y_i f = 1$，通常 $\alpha_i > 0$：它是支持向量。

label.en: A correctly classified point inside the street, with $0 < \xi < 1$.
label.zh: 街道里面分对的点，$0 < \xi < 1$。

feedback.en: It violates its margin constraint, so its multiplier is at the cap $C$: a support vector.
feedback.zh: 它违反了自己的间隔约束，乘子到了上界 $C$：支持向量。

label.en: A misclassified point, with $\xi > 1$.
label.zh: 被分错的点，$\xi > 1$。

feedback.en: It has the largest slack, $\alpha_i = C$: a support vector, and exactly the kind of point that pulls the boundary.
feedback.zh: 它的松弛最大，$\alpha_i = C$：是支持向量，而且正是会拉动边界的那种点。

label.en: A point well outside the street, with $y_i f \gg 1$.
label.zh: 远在街道之外的点，$y_i f \gg 1$。

explain.en: Complementary slackness: $\alpha_i = 0$ whenever $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) > 1$. Only points on or inside the margin, or misclassified, are support vectors.
explain.zh: 互补松弛：只要 $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) > 1$，就有 $\alpha_i = 0$。只有在间隔上、间隔里或被分错的点才是支持向量。

title.en: Section A style: slack, $C$ and logistic regression
title.zh: A 部分题型：松弛、$C$ 与逻辑回归

prompt.en: In three or four lines: (a) what do the slack variables and the parameter $C$ do in a soft-margin SVM? (b) Give one difference between how an SVM and logistic regression treat a training point that is far on the correct side of the boundary.
prompt.zh: 用三四行回答：(a) 软间隔 SVM 里的松弛变量和参数 $C$ 起什么作用？(b) 对一个远在边界正确一侧的训练点，SVM 与逻辑回归的处理方式有什么不同？

key_points.en: slack xi_i: how far point i violates its margin constraint (0 if fine, >1 if misclassified)
key_points.zh: 松弛 xi_i：点 i 违反间隔约束多少（没问题为 0，分错则 >1）

key_points.en: C: price of slack; large C = few violations, narrow margin; small C = wide margin, more violations
key_points.zh: C：松弛的价格；C 大 = 违规少、间隔窄；C 小 = 间隔宽、违规多

key_points.en: SVM: a point beyond the margin has zero loss and zero influence (not a support vector)
key_points.zh: SVM：间隔之外的点损失为零、没有影响（不是支持向量）

key_points.en: logistic regression: loss never exactly zero, every point still contributes a little gradient
key_points.zh: 逻辑回归：损失永远不恰好为零，每个点仍贡献一点梯度

model_answer.en: (a) The slack variable xi_i measures how much point i violates its margin constraint y_i(w.x_i + b) >= 1 (xi_i = 0 if it is on or outside its margin, 0 < xi_i < 1 if inside the margin, xi_i > 1 if misclassified). The objective 1/2 ||w||^2 + C sum xi_i trades a wide margin against violations: a large C makes violations expensive, giving a narrow margin that fits the training data closely (risk of overfitting); a small C gives a wide margin with more violations (risk of underfitting). C is chosen by cross-validation. (b) For an SVM a point far beyond the margin has hinge loss 0 and alpha_i = 0, so it has no influence on the boundary; logistic regression has a loss that never reaches 0, so every point, even a well-classified one, still contributes a small gradient.
model_answer.zh: (a) The slack variable xi_i measures how much point i violates its margin constraint y_i(w.x_i + b) >= 1 (xi_i = 0 if it is on or outside its margin, 0 < xi_i < 1 if inside the margin, xi_i > 1 if misclassified). The objective 1/2 ||w||^2 + C sum xi_i trades a wide margin against violations: a large C makes violations expensive, giving a narrow margin that fits the training data closely (risk of overfitting); a small C gives a wide margin with more violations (risk of underfitting). C is chosen by cross-validation. (b) For an SVM a point far beyond the margin has hinge loss 0 and alpha_i = 0, so it has no influence on the boundary; logistic regression has a loss that never reaches 0, so every point, even a well-classified one, still contributes a small gradient.

explain.en: Part (a) wants the roles of both symbols and the direction of the trade-off; part (b) is the hinge-versus-logistic contrast of the comparison page.
explain.zh: (a) 要说出两个符号的作用和权衡的方向；(b) 是对比页里 hinge 与 logistic 的区别。

title.en: What to remember: support vector machines
title.zh: 要记住的：支持向量机

rows.en: $\hat y = \text{sign}(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b)$, labels $\pm1$; $\mathbf{w}$ perpendicular to the boundary
rows.zh: $\hat y = \text{sign}(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x} + b)$，标签 $\pm1$；$\mathbf{w}$ 垂直于边界

rows.en: $\dfrac{y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b)}{\|\mathbf{w}\|}$ geometric; without the denominator: functional
rows.zh: $\dfrac{y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b)}{\|\mathbf{w}\|}$ 是几何间隔；不除以分母则是函数间隔

rows.en: $\gamma_g = \min_i \dfrac{y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b)}{\|\mathbf{w}\|}$; in the scale where the nearest points have $y_i f = 1$: $\gamma = 1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$, street width $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$
rows.zh: $\gamma_g = \min_i \dfrac{y_i(\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}_i + b)}{\|\mathbf{w}\|}$；取最近点 $y_i f = 1$ 的尺度时：$\gamma = 1/\|\mathbf{w}\|$，街道宽 $2/\|\mathbf{w}\|$

rows.en: points with tight constraints ($y_i f = 1$); the solution is sparse; LOO error $\le$ #SV$/n$
rows.zh: 约束取等号的点（$y_i f = 1$）；解是稀疏的；LOO 误差 $\le$ 支持向量数$/n$
把 $\mathbf{x}_i^\top\mathbf{x}_j$ 换成 $K(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{x}_j) = \phi(\mathbf{x}_i)^\top\phi(\mathbf{x}_j)$：线性、多项式 $(\mathbf{x}^\top\mathbf{z}+c)^d$、RBF $e^{-\gamma\|\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{z}\|^2}$

rows.en: $\min \tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2 + C\sum_i\xi_i$ s.t. $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) \ge 1 - \xi_i$, $\xi_i \ge 0$; $\xi = 0$ / $(0,1)$ / $>1$: on-or-outside / inside / misclassified
rows.zh: $\min \tfrac12\|\mathbf{w}\|^2 + C\sum_i\xi_i$，约束 $y_i f(\mathbf{x}_i) \ge 1 - \xi_i$，$\xi_i \ge 0$；$\xi = 0$ / $(0,1)$ / $>1$：在线上或之外 / 在街内 / 被分错

rows.en: large: few violations, narrow margin, overfit; small: wide margin, many violations; tune by CV; $1/C \sim \lambda$
rows.zh: 大：违规少、间隔窄、过拟合；小：间隔宽、违规多；用 CV 调；$1/C \sim \lambda$

rows.en: $k$ weight vectors learned jointly with margin 1 against every other class, $\arg\max_y \boldsymbol{\theta}_y^\top \mathbf{x}$; or one-vs-rest ($k$), one-vs-one ($k(k-1)/2$)
rows.zh: $k$ 个权重向量联合学习，对每个其他类别间隔为 1，$\arg\max_y \boldsymbol{\theta}_y^\top \mathbf{x}$；或一对多（$k$ 个）、一对一（$k(k-1)/2$ 个）

rows.en: max margin, convex, high-dimensional data / outliers, non-separable (hard), tune $C$, linear only (without kernels)
rows.zh: 最大间隔、凸、适合高维 / 离群点、不可分（硬间隔）、要调 $C$、只能线性（不用核时）
对比 LR 与感知机

rows.en: hinge: zero beyond the margin, sparse, no probabilities; logistic: never zero, probabilities; perceptron: zero once correct, any separator
rows.zh: hinge：间隔之外为零、稀疏、没有概率；logistic：永不为零、有概率；感知机：对了就为零、任一分隔线
